Container.Name: risk-seven
Container.Overview: Risk Seven table. First to 200. Set only Port (the host port). Leave the container port at 8765. Leave the WebUI URL at the top unchanged. Do not add another port. A second copy is another container with a different name and a different host port.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The only port you set. This is the host port (e.g. 9010). The container port stays 8765 — do not change it. Do not add another port. Do not edit WebUI at the top.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public https origin if you use a reverse proxy, e.g. https://riskseven.example.com
